intent.description: Search for round-trip or one-way flights on Google Flights between two cities for given dates.
intent.userSaid: i just searched for flights from San Fran to Tokyo. i messed around with all the filters available. i clicked one of the departure flights. i clicked one of the arrival options, its now showing me the cost and booking options etc. i changed from round trip to one way

parameters.name: origin_id
parameters.description: Google Knowledge Graph ID for the origin city (e.g. /m/0d6lp for San Francisco)

parameters.name: origin_type
parameters.description: Origin location type: 4 for city, 5 for metro area

parameters.name: destination_id
parameters.description: Google Knowledge Graph ID for the destination city (e.g. /m/07dfk for Tokyo)

parameters.name: destination_type
parameters.description: Destination location type: 4 for city, 5 for metro area

parameters.name: depart_date
parameters.description: Outbound departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format

parameters.name: return_date
parameters.description: Return departure date in YYYY-MM-DD format (for round trips)

parameters.name: trip_type
parameters.description: Trip type: 1 for one-way, 3 for round-trip
